response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT g.gender, g.order_count, g.order_count - a.avg_order_count AS difference_above_average FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_order_count;
